title: Kapperman White Eyecare
description: kwmeyecare.com Kapperman McGarvey Eye Group, known as KWM Eyecare, is an independent optometry practice in Chattanooga, Tennessee, founded in 1988 by Dr. Mark R. Kapperman. Now led by four doctors, Kapperman, his son Conner, Dr. Robert McGarvey and Air Force veteran Dr. Megan Kortum, it offers comprehensive medical eye exams, pediatric care, and treatment for glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, dry eye and retinal emergencies. Its technology includes Lumenis Optilight IPL, digital retinal imaging, OCT, Neurolens and virtual visual field testing, plus an online eyewear shop with Prada and Silhouette frames. The practice works with 18 plus insurance plans, accepts contact lens fittings from daily disposable to scleral and ortho-k lenses, and runs a unique four day work week for staff. Recognized as a CooperVision Best Practices 2020 honoree and member of Vision Source since 2008, its doctors have completed over 20 international vision mission trips to Honduras and other countries.
